For an object (S), its '''centre of inertia''' $C$ is at:

{{#content:Q2039}}

In a cartesian coordinate system, it can be equivalently stipulated that:

$$
\begin{cases}
x_G=\frac{1}{m}\int_{S}x_{dm} dm \\
y_G=\frac{1}{m}\int_{S}y_{dm} dm \\
z_G=\frac{1}{m}\int_{S}z_{dm} dm
\end{cases}
$$

== Properties ==

=== Motion ===

The motion of object (S) can be decomposed into:

# the translation of (S) in space
# the rotation of different parts of (S) according to its centre of inertia

=== Gravity ===

See [[centre of gravity]].
